Handle.HandleStory:
I am a music composer/producer from Greece. Commodore 64 user/lover since the early-mid 80s. SID music was and still is fascinating/kinda addicting to me and I always wanted to be a part of it and contribute to the scene with my own SID music and also my pixel art and PETSCII creations. I never thought as a child that one day I will be testing/listening to my own SID files on my childhood C64 but here we are!
https://www.youtube.com/@DJSpaceRetrotunes https://www.facebook.com/djspace.music http://www.retroperks.com

Scener.Trivia: Listen to my published SID tunes at The High Voltage SID Collection, www.hvsc.c64.org, under the name Wijnhoven_Joachim.

Megasoft Argentina was one of the first computer and video game stores founded by Juan Jose (juanete) and one of the most well-known and productive C64, Amiga, Zx Spectrum, MSX, Pc Computers cracking groups in today's Argentina, formed in late 1982, where they remain active to this day, selling hardware from the best brands on the market.
Added to the info : The store opened around 1986, and it all started with the help of my parents (Kike and Cata)... Megasoft came to mind in 1982, when it all began as a hobby on the beloved C64... and then I delved into the glorious world of machine code. I was a huge fan of Micromania magazine, where I could see all the new releases. Things arrived a bit late in my country, but it was the only way we had to get an idea of ​​what was coming out, until the BBS world arrived. My huge collection of magazines decorated the store walls in a unique style, making that beautiful place unforgettable for my friends and customers.
(This is dedicated especially to Kike and Cata, mis viejos !! ... who trusted where we wanted to go currently.)

Scener.Trivia:
Megasoft were Argentinian crackers, they also made intros for other groups and computer stores in Argentina in the '80s.
Currently active from 1982 - 2026, coding intros and art on c64/amiga/PC Computers.
